shortDescription: Cooler Master MWE Gold V3 850W ATX 3.1 Non-Modular Power Supply (80 PLUS Gold Certified / Dedicated 12V-2x6 PCIe 5.1 Connector / 120mm HDB Fan / Active PFC / Full Protections / MPE-8506-ACAG-B / 1-Year Local Warranty)Pow
descriptionHtml:
Cooler Master MWE Gold V3 850W ATX 3.1 Non-Modular Power Supply (80 PLUS Gold Certified / Dedicated 12V-2x6 PCIe 5.1 Connector / 120mm HDB Fan / Active PFC / Full Protections / MPE-8506-ACAG-B / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Power up high-end gaming platforms with reliable energy efficiency using the Cooler Master MWE Gold V3 850W ATX 3.1 Power Supply, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Engineered to strict ATX 3.1 standards, this 850-watt non-modular PSU features a native 12V-2x6 (12+4 pin) power connector to safely handle power spikes from modern graphics cards. Boasting an official 80 PLUS Gold efficiency rating exceeding 90% under typical loads, it operates smoothly with an active PFC design and a whisper-quiet 120mm Hydro Dynamic Bearing (HDB) cooling fan running up to 2400 RPM. Protected by a comprehensive suite of industrial-grade electrical guards including OVP, OPP, SCP, OTP, OCP, and UVP, it delivers rock-solid performance for demanding desktop builds.
